name: Scheme for Pension Benefits to the Journalists/Photojournalists
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be 18 years or older. 1. The applicant retired from the job as an accredited journalist/photojournalist in Tripura. 1. The applicant should have done 10 years of service in Tripura. 1. The applicant should not have received a pension from other sources, except under the Employees Provident Fund (EPF). 1. The beneficiary should be 60 years or older to receive the pension.
